headline: Where is my soulmate right now?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x where. ⛔ THE DEFINING BAN IS THAT NO PLACE MAY BE NAMED — not a town, a room, a job, a website, a distance. This gap was found the hard way: every frame withheld 'a name, a date, or exactly who' and omitted WHERE.
⛔ NO TACTIC. Nothing she could act on — no 'get out more', no 'look closer to home'. Never her fault.
🔴 The method suits this frame unusually well: it answers about the BLOCK instead of the location, so the banned answer is never even approached.
⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. ⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE.

⚠ The one lander whose headline asks directly for the banned answer. Beat 3 affirms that he is REAL (the allowed hopeful direction) and says nothing about location; beat 5 moves the question off 'where' altogether.

readback.1 would a person say this: Yes. 'And nobody's told you why' is plain speech.
readback.2 is every noun real: Four solid objects, the rope and tree, the mid-step feet — all on the card.
readback.3 anything she could catch me getting wr: No. Beat 4 says he is not here and nobody has told her why. Neither is checkable against her life.
readback.4 does the symbol prove the line at a gl: Yes. Four things you could pick up prove 'he's real enough' with no explaining.
readback.5 does the card mean what TAROT_CARD_VOC: Yes — the Hanged Man read as held rather than gone, which is Waite's own point.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through, and your hand found the busiest of the three.
Look at his hands. One is up, one is down, and neither is empty.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. What catches me is how much of this card is already in use.
Still, nobody has come. And what you want from me is a where.
Something turns up right when this would get anywhere. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was held by one rope.
Look at the rope. It's tied at one ankle, and nothing else holds him.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. The rope goes up into the beam, and that's what holds my attention.
And yet nobody has come. And you're asking me to point somewhere.
The hold is fixed, and it stays put. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing told them apart, and you took the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. That's all he's carrying.
You asked where your soulmate is right now. Travelling, and what gets carried with it — that's where this one puts me.
But nobody has come. And you're the one asking for a location.
Something is sitting right in the middle of this. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
